name: Gust Knuckleplate
description: Jab the brass at the seam where breastplate meets gorget, testing the armor with a quick sharp knock.

name: Gust Bandarch
description: Slip to the side of a mailed opponent's swing and step in close to the neck guard.

name: Ringgreave
description: Knock an armored fist aside with the flat of the brass-wrapped forearm before it lands.

name: Aegisstud
description: Crouch behind the fists and let the strength of qi in the forearms hold against heavy blows.

name: Blaze Overhand
description: Hammer the brass along a line of rivets with qi packed into the blow until the plate shudders against the body.

name: Tempered Ringband
description: Dent a plate with the first blow and send a looping hook into the same weakened spot.

name: Knuckthrash
description: Drive one qi-charged punch into the breastplate so the shock passes through the metal into the ribs behind.

name: Iron Handfill
description: Press the charged boss into an armor seam and hold the pressure until straps and padding give way.

name: Ironslab
description: Rap the ring lightly on an iron cap or cuirass to hear where the metal is thin.

name: Iron Haymaker
description: Bring the ringed fist down from above onto a raised shield rim like a smith's hammer.

name: Silencing Hooking
description: Hook a ring over the rim of a shield and pull it wide to open the body behind.

name: Granite Palmbar
description: Step wide of a heavy weapon's swing and plant the lead foot beside the wielder's plate.

name: Chime Fistbar
description: Turn the brass forearm outward so a mace head glances away from the body.

name: Wrecking Brassring
description: Charge the ring with qi and strike the rim of an iron cap until the metal begins to bend.

name: Crippling Uppercut
description: Wedge the boss under a shield rim and lever steadily so the shield lifts from the arm holding it.

name: Gust Brassrim
description: Turn a mace blow off the forearm brass and return a qi-backed punch to the open ribs.

name: Harrowing Glint Bandarch
description: Drop the weight through the fist so a single boss strike drives through a thin plate and the flesh beneath.

name: Rumblestud
description: Gather qi in the fist over three breaths and release it in one blow that splits an iron plate along its length.

name: Blaze Fistbar
description: Jab with the brass so the edge of the qi field touches the target a breath before the metal does.

name: Silt Knockout
description: Step out with the qi field spread wide around the body, sensing the opponent's approach before it comes.

name: Facetslab
description: Raise the fists behind a thin skin of the qi field that softens each blow on the forearms.

name: Mayhem Brawl
description: Rap the brass on the opponent's outer wrist at the edge of the field to unsettle their reach.

name: Splintering Palmbar
description: Extend the qi field down the arm so every blow in a three-blow chain carries a share of its force.

name: Slabcuirass
description: Wrap the forearm in the field and turn a punch around it, taking its force in the turn.

name: Chime Studplate
description: Press the boss against the margin of the opponent's own qi and hold until their guard flickers.

name: Gustring
description: Draw the field into the closed fist and release it all at contact so the brass hits with the whole body's force.

name: Rumble Ringband
description: Hold the boss against the opponent's qi field and push steadily until it tears open at the point of contact.

name: Ironstud
description: Throw the lead straight at full reach with the shoulder behind it and the elbow snapping out.

name: Brawlbarrage
description: Cross the rear fist along a long straight line so the brass arrives from outside the opponent's view.

name: Knuckleplate Spurt
description: Slip the lead foot out and in so the body stays just beyond an opponent's counter reach.

name: Thorn Knuckleridge
description: Hold the lead fist out as a frame and keep the rear fist close, covering both ranges.

name: Enduring Studplate
description: Sweep the outstretched brass in an outer arc and carry an incoming punch away from the face.

name: Chime Overhand
description: Tap the brass on a fully straightened elbow to make the arm buckle at the joint.

name: Sanguine Knockout
description: Let a short tongue of qi run beyond the knuckles so the jab lands a hand's width past its usual reach.

name: Gustbrawl
description: Pivot on the lead foot with the fist swung wide so the step ends inside the opponent's range.

name: Mayhem Handfill
description: Hook the ring over the opponent's wrist at full extension and haul them into the next blow.

name: Rupturing Knuckleridge
description: Stretch to the limit and drive a qi-charged boss through the guard along one narrow line.

name: Brassring Assault
description: Strike out at full reach, snap the fist back for cover and strike again in one continuous motion.

name: Blaze Brawl
description: Jab with one ringed fist while the other hangs ready on a second track beside it.

name: Soaring Uppercut
description: Slip off the line while both hands keep their places, one forward and one guarding.

name: Implacable Knuckleridge
description: Knock a blow aside with the near fist and set the far fist onto the opposite track.

name: Thorn Brassrim
description: Hold both fists in a matched cover so a thread of qi runs evenly through each forearm.

name: Gustslab
description: Cross the fists on their two tracks, left over right, each blow carrying a pulse of qi.

name: Thorn Hooking
description: Close both brass fists on the opponent's wrists and press them together to lock the arms.

name: Rumble Brawl
description: Strike with both fists on two tracks so the opponent can cover only one and the other breaks through.

name: Enduring Fistbar
description: Anchor one fist to turn the blow aside and send the other through the opening it leaves.

name: Iron Brassrim
description: Settle into a high perch with fists drawn close, watching the opponent as a hawk watches the ground.

name: Harpooning Knuckleplate
description: Jab with the fingers curled in the rings like talons so the brass lands in a hooked snap.

name: Silt Haymaker
description: Hop lightly off the back foot to shift the perch a pace to either side.

name: Blazestud
description: Swing two hooks in quick succession at the same ribs, each curving in from a different side.

name: Murkstud
description: Drop under a high blow as a hawk stoops and knock it clear with the lifted forearm.

name: Harpooning Knockout
description: Fall from the perch into a straight punch with qi flowing down the arm as the body drops.

name: Compressing Hooking
description: Close both brass fists on the opponent's lead arm and hold it pinned as talons hold prey.

name: Rumbleslab
description: Beat the fists in quick alternation against the opponent's guard to rattle its hold.

name: Mightknuck
description: Leap from the perch and bring both brass fists down together on the opponent's guard with falling weight.

name: Gyve Handfill
description: Seize the opponent's arms in both fists and hold them under crushing pressure fed by the qi field.

name: Sanguine Studplate
description: Jab from the rim of the stance, qi drawn up from the low center and carried out through the brass.

name: Soaring Bandarch
description: Slide the feet smoothly along the ground as a river runs, keeping the stance level.

name: Facetknuck
description: Cup both fists before the chest like a bowl so incoming blows pool against the forearms.

name: Chimeknuck
description: Let the forearm flow with an incoming punch, guiding it away along its own line.

name: Crippling Ringband
description: Rap the brass on the opponent's chest as their breath pools to break the rhythm of their next move.

name: Sanguine Haymaker
description: Cross the rear fist in a long outer line like a river bend and land the brass on the jaw.

name: Unmaking Knuckleridge
description: Lift qi from the low center in one swell and drive the uppercut up under the chin.

name: Lambasting Palmbar
description: Link three hooks as a river links its bends, each carrying the qi on to the next.

name: Ringhauberk
description: Turn the body in a small eddy that swirls a blow past it and returns a hook.

name: Studcloak
description: Lean the pooled weight of the body onto the opponent's arms and press them down like settling silt.

name: Harrowing Knockout
description: Fill the basin of the body with qi for several breaths, then let it pour through the brass in one blow.

name: Toxin Studplate
description: Haul the opponent's arm sharply toward you like an undertow and drive the free fist into the open side.

name: Tearing Overhand
description: Speak the oath under the breath and throw the straight jab that fulfils it.

name: Overhand Pounce
description: Step across the wind's line as the opponent swings, letting the gust carry the body off target.

name: Studgreave
description: Keep the fists raised in the sworn guard and refuse to give ground while the blows land.

name: Gust Handfill
description: Take the bearing of an incoming blow and turn the forearm to send it past on that line.

name: Might Uppercut
description: Run three sworn blows on one breath, each pushed along by qi as wind pushes a flame.

name: Mayhem Haymaker
description: Rap the brass along the line of the opponent's arm to throw off the strike they had sworn to land.

name: Gust Brassring
description: Lean into the opponent's rush like a man into a headwind and meet it with a firm hook.

name: Brawlassault
description: Hold the oath through every blow of the exchange and send a heavy cross when it is fulfilled.

name: Knuckcuirass
description: Take the bearing on the opponent's arm and press both brass fists against it, holding it pinned.

name: Drubbing Uppercut
description: Jab from the open footing of the plateau rim with the lead foot planted wide.

name: Silt Ringband
description: Stride long across level ground to meet or leave the opponent before they set their feet.

name: Thorn Bandarch
description: Keep the fists wide and high at the edge of the stance so no blow finds the head.

name: Gust Palmbar
description: Roll the forearm along an incoming fist like a stone along the rim and off into the open air.

name: Might Fistbar
description: Cross the rear fist with the full drop of the body, as if falling off a ledge into the blow.

name: Toxin Brassrim
description: Rap the brass on the opponent's lifted foot as it comes down in the dust to spoil their footing.

name: Might Brawl
description: Run along the rim in a series of long steps and blows, each driven by a pulse of qi.

name: Chime Knuckleplate
description: Turn at the edge of the footing so the opponent's charge passes, and strike as it does.

name: Rumble Knuckleplate
description: Check the opponent's shoulder at the moment of a gust to tip them toward the edge.

name: Iron Hooking
description: Throw the weight from the rim into a falling hammer fist that drives the opponent's guard downward.

name: Guststud
description: Let a stride's momentum carry the body round the opponent's flank into a wide qi-driven hook.

name: Fistbar Thrash
description: Take a bearing on the opponent's centre and send the jab straight along it.

name: Torrent Brassring
description: Step so the same bearing on the opponent holds while the distance and angle change.

name: Steadfast Handfill
description: Spread the fists wide in an open guard that offers no cover to hide behind and gives no target.

name: Resilient Bandarch
description: Turn across an incoming punch's line like a crosswind and brush it past the shoulder.

name: Knockout Thrash
description: Cross the rear fist down the held bearing so it lands where the jab already marked.

name: Chime Ringband
description: Tap the opponent's back arm as they turn away, adding to their own turning momentum to unbalance them.

name: Might Brassrim
description: Hold the bearing through a step and throw a qi-backed straight that lands as the opponent shifts.

name: Trouncing Overhand
description: Chain two hooks from the windward side, the second following the first on the same line.

name: Chime Palmbar
description: Slip to the leeward side of a blow and answer with a hook to the unguarded ribs.

name: Gyve Uppercut
description: Step into the gap in the opponent's guard and press both fists on their arms to hold them there.

name: Iron Knuckleridge
description: Send the full weight of the held bearing through a charged boss into a single point of the guard.

name: Blazering
description: Gather the qi field into the fist over a held breath and release it all through one oath-sworn blow.
